claim.quote: When combined with CMB lensing from ACT and Planck, and baryon acoustic oscillation data from DESI DR1, we measure a baryon density of $\Omega_b h^2=0.0226\pm0.0001$, a cold dark matter density of $\Omega_c h^2=0.118\pm0.001$, a Hubble constant of $H_0=68.22\pm0.36$ km/s/Mpc

name: The Atacama Cosmology Telescope: DR6 Power Spectra, Likelihoods and $Λ$CDM Parameters

official_url.quote: The Atacama Cosmology Telescope: DR6 Power Spectra, Likelihoods and $Λ$CDM Parameters

summary.plain: The Atacama Cosmology Telescope's final data release gives power spectra of the Big Bang afterglow over 19,000 square degrees. Combined with other data they fit the standard cosmological model and give a Hubble constant of about 68.
summary.technical: ACT DR6 (19,000 deg^2 at 98/150/220 GHz): TT/TE/EE spectra over 10,000 deg^2 fit by LCDM + foregrounds; with Planck (P-ACT), lensing and DESI DR1 BAO: H0 = 68.22 +/- 0.36, n_s = 0.974 +/- 0.003, sigma_8 = 0.813 +/- 0.005; no evidence for excess lensing or departure from flatness.

title: The Atacama Cosmology Telescope: DR6 Power Spectra, Likelihoods and $Λ$CDM Parameters
why_it_matters: The abstract reports "no evidence for excess lensing in the power spectrum, and no departure from spatial flatness" and agreement of LCDM parameters between P-ACT and DESI DR2 at the 1.6σ level.
